title: Senior Health & Safety Specialis
description:
**Role Description**
The Senior Health & Safety Specialist will provide expert guidance on occupational health and safety practices to support CareerCompass GH and its clients. This part-time remote role involves assessing workplace risks, developing and reviewing safety policies, and advising on compliance with relevant health and safety regulations and standards. The specialist will design and deliver safety training materials and virtual workshops, support the integration of Environment Health and Safety (EHS) principles into organizational processes, and recommend corrective actions following audits or incident reports. Day-to-day tasks include conducting remote assessments, preparing clear documentation and reports, collaborating with internal stakeholders and client organizations, and continuously monitoring best practices in health, safety, and workplace wellbeing.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated expertise in Health & Safety and Workplace Safety, with a track record of implementing effective safety programs.
* Strong background in Occupational Health and Environment Health and Safety (EHS), including risk assessment and regulatory compliance.
* Experience designing and delivering Safety Training, workshops, and educational materials for diverse audiences.
* Relevant professional certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent) and a degree in Occupational Health, Safety Management, Environmental Science, or a related field.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple stakeholders, and communicate complex safety concepts clearly in written and spoken English.
* Proficiency with digital tools for remote collaboration, documentation, and training delivery; experience advising service-focused or educational organizations is an advantage.

title: Legal Advisor
description:
**We are #hiring Legal Advisor at Jay Jay Mills (India) Pvt Ltd!**

Department – Human Resourse

Location – Sipcot, Erode District or Tirupur

Employment Type - Full-Time

Salary – salary offered the best in the Industry.

Reports To – DGM - HR

**Job Summary**

The Legal Advisor will be responsible for providing legal guidance and support to the organization on all legal, regulatory, compliance, labor, and contractual matters related to the garment and textile industry. The role involves ensuring compliance with applicable laws, minimizing legal risks, handling litigation, and supporting business operations through effective legal counsel.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Legal Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Monitor changes in labor, industrial, environmental, and commercial laws affecting the textile and garment industry.
* Advise management on legal implications of business decisions.

**Contract Management**

* Draft, review, negotiate, and vet agreements, including:
* Vendor and supplier agreements
* Customer contracts
* Employment contracts
* Service agreements
* Lease and rental agreements
* Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)
* Maintain and manage contract records.

**Labor & Industrial Relations**

* Provide legal support on labor law matters, including:
* Factories Act
* Industrial Relations Code
* Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code
* Social Security laws (PF, ESI, Gratuity, etc.)
* Handle disciplinary proceedings, domestic enquiries, and employee grievances.
* Advise HR on employee-related legal issues.

**Litigation & Dispute Management**

* Coordinate with external advocates and legal consultants.
* Handle court cases, labor disputes, arbitration matters, and legal notices.
* Prepare legal documentation and responses.
* Maintain records of ongoing and completed legal cases.

**Corporate Governance**

* Assist in drafting company policies and procedures.
* Ensure legal compliance in corporate governance matters.
* Support management during audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews.

**Risk Management**

* Identify legal risks and recommend mitigation measures.
* Review business practices to ensure legal compliance.
* Provide legal training and awareness sessions for employees and management.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in law (LLB) from a recognized university.
* 8 -10 years of experience in legal advisory, preferably in the garment, textile, manufacturing, or industrial sector.
* Strong knowledge of labor laws, commercial contracts, and industrial regulations.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent drafting and negotiation skills.
* Strong knowledge of labor and industrial laws.
* Contract management expertise.
* Litigation and dispute resolution skills.
* Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and maintain confidentiality.

Interested candidates may send your resume to
**careers@jayjaymills.com or mbhuvaneshwari@jayjaymills.in**

description:

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced
**Manager – Microsoft Purview**
to design, implement, and support enterprise data protection and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Microsoft Purview Data Security services, including
**Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Classification and Sensitivity Labelling, Insider Risk Management, and Data Lifecycle Management**
. The candidate should also possess sound understanding of
**DSPM for AI and Data Governance.**
The professional will work closely with business stakeholders, compliance teams, and technical teams to protect sensitive information, reduce insider risks, and ensure regulatory compliance across the organization's data estate.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Data Loss Prevention (DLP)**

* Design, implement, and optimize Microsoft Purview DLP policies across Microsoft 365 services, endpoints, and supported third-party repositories.
* Define detection logic using Sensitive Information Types (SITs), trainable classifiers, custom classifiers, and EDM.
* Monitor DLP incidents and provide recommendations for policy tuning and risk reduction.
* Support deployment of Endpoint DLP controls for data exfiltration prevention.

**Data Classification & Labelling**

* Develop enterprise data classification frameworks aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Configure and manage Sensitivity Labels, Label Policies, Auto-labelling, and Mandatory Labelling strategies.
* Perform data discovery and classification workshops with business stakeholders.
* Support protection technologies including encryption, content markings, and access controls.

**DSPM for AI**

* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI policies, assessments, and risk monitoring.
* Investigate AI-related data exposure, oversharing, and compliance risks.
* Develop AI governance use cases focused on responsible AI adoption and data protection.
* Deliver AI risk insights, posture reports, and executive dashboards.

**Data Governance**

* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview Data Governance capabilities and services.
* Drive data discovery, classification, cataloguing, and lineage initiatives.
* Develop governance frameworks for data quality, ownership, compliance, and lifecycle management.
* Produce governance metrics, compliance reports, and executive dashboards.

**Insider Risk Management**

* Configure and manage Insider Risk Management policies and analytics.
* Investigate insider risk alerts and collaborate with security, legal, compliance, and HR teams during investigations.
* Develop insider risk use cases focused on data theft, data leakage, security policy violations, and privilege misuse.
* Produce risk reports and executive dashboards.

**Data Lifecycle Management**

* Implement retention labels, retention policies, disposition reviews, and records management controls.
* Support regulatory and compliance requirements through information governance processes.
* Assist in defining data retention schedules and defensible data disposal strategies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to automate lifecycle management processes.

**Consulting & Delivery**

* Conduct workshops, assessments, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Develop solution designs, implementation plans, and governance frameworks.
* Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), pilot deployments, and production rollouts.
* Create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Provide troubleshooting support and operational guidance for Purview solutions.
* Stay current with Microsoft Purview roadmap, emerging data protection trends, and compliance requirements.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview Data Security and Compliance solutions.
* Expertise in:

+ Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
+ Sensitivity Labels and Information Protection
+ Data Classification and Governance
+ Insider Risk Management
+ DSPM for AI
+ Data Governance
+ Data Lifecycle Management (desirable)
+ Records Management (desirable)
+ Communication Compliance (desirable)
+ eDiscovery (desirable)

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Compliance Centre and Microsoft Purview Portal.
* Understanding of regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST, and data privacy requirements.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Defender XDR, and Microsoft Security ecosystem integrations.
* Knowledge of cloud security and Microsoft 365 architecture.

**Professional Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
* Ability to translate business requirements into security controls and governance policies.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Consulting mindset with client-facing experience.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 9+ years of experience in data protection, information security, compliance, or Microsoft 365 security technologies.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Excellent analytical skills and knowledge of data analytics methods
* Demonstrated leadership abilities
* Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, communication, and presentation skills

**Relevant certifications preferred:**

* Microsoft Certified: Information Protection Administrator (SC-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Security Administrator Associate (MS-500)
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills.
* CISSP, CISA, CISM, CEH, CIPPE/M, Technical (Vendor) Certifications.

title: migration Visa Counsellor
description:
**Company Description**
Aussizz Group is a migration and education consulting organization founded in 2009 from the lived experience of migrants seeking a new home. The group has grown into a family of over 600 professionals and more than 70 Registered Migration Agents, supporting individuals, students, artists, and professionals worldwide. Trusted by over 195,000 individuals and 9,000 students each year, Aussizz Group combines expert guidance with integrity and client care. The company leverages digital tools and a large network of offices to simplify migration journeys and stay close to clients. Its mission goes beyond visa processing, focusing on dignity, opportunity, and long-term success for every client.
  
**Role Description**
The Migration Visa Counsellor is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role involves advising clients on suitable visa options, explaining eligibility requirements, and guiding them through application procedures and documentation. The counsellor will conduct detailed assessments of client profiles, prepare and review forms and supporting documents, and coordinate with internal teams and registered migration agents to ensure accurate and timely submissions. Daily responsibilities include responding to client inquiries, scheduling and conducting consultations, maintaining case records in internal systems, and keeping clients updated on application progress and policy changes. The role also includes participating in information sessions, maintaining up-to-date knowledge of relevant immigration regulations, and contributing to a professional, client-centered service environment.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong client service skills, including active listening, clear communication, and the ability to explain complex information in simple terms.
* Experience in counselling, advisory, or consulting roles, preferably in migration, education, or related compliance-focused services.
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities to handle multiple cases, documentation, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency with office productivity tools and case management or CRM systems for maintaining accurate records.
* Attention to detail and high accuracy in reviewing and preparing forms, documents, and client information.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and work effectively in a fast-paced, on-site office environment.
* Strong written and spoken communication skills in English; knowledge of additional regional or international languages is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; qualifications in law, international relations, business, or social sciences are preferred but not mandatory.
* Demonstrated professionalism, ethical conduct, and a client-focused mindset aligned with Aussizz Group’s values of integrity and respect.
* Prior experience in migration services or visa processing is highly beneficial, though motivated candidates with relevant advisory experience are encouraged to apply.

title: AML Analyst-Senior Executive-Ahmedabad
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an AML Analyst to support M-Pesa financial crime risk management by identifying, investigating, and monitoring suspicious transactions. The role focuses on ensuring timely escalation of potential risks, maintaining high-quality investigation records, and supporting compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and internal policies. This opportunity is based in Ahmedabad and involves close collaboration with internal stakeholders including the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Assess daily AML alerts and ensure timely closure or escalation of outstanding cases
* Escalate confirmed suspicious activities promptly to the AML Supervisor and MLRO
* Conduct sanctions and Politically Exposed Person (PEP) screening and customer profile reviews
* Review transaction monitoring alerts in line with established procedures and investigation standards
* Evaluate transaction patterns, including geographic relevance of remitters and beneficiaries
* Maintain accurate, clear, and auditable records of all investigations and decisions
* Support preparation of monthly AML reports and management information dashboards
* Provide insights to stakeholders on emerging risks and transaction monitoring trends
* Ensure compliance with personal data protection standards and internal governance processes
* Work effectively with systems and tools supporting AML monitoring and investigations

**Who You Are**

* Experience of 2–3 years within a financial services or AML-focused environment (AML exposure preferred)
* Understanding of AML frameworks, controls, and industry best practices
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail, with a structured approach to investigations
* Ability to manage workload independently with a focus on quality and timeliness
* Proficiency in MS Office tools for reporting and analysisEffective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly
* Demonstrates accountability, proactive problem-solving, and continuous improvement mindset
* Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Law, Finance, Management, or a related discipline

If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.

* Exposure to global financial crime compliance practices within a leading telecommunications organisation
* Opportunity to work on M-Pesa, a widely recognised digital financial services platform
* A collaborative and supportive environment that encourages continuous learning
* Development of specialised AML investigation and risk assessment expertise
* Experience working with cross-functional and international stakeholders

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced transaction monitoring and AML investigation techniques
* Sanctions screening and PEP risk assessment methodologies
* Risk identification, escalation protocols, and regulatory reporting practices
* Data analysis and interpretation for financial crime trends
* Stakeholder communication and compliance reporting skills

The Registrar is the Chief Administrative Officer of the University and plays a pivotal role in ensuring effective governance, statutory compliance, academic administration, and institutional operations. The position is responsible for maintaining the integrity of university records, facilitating coordination across academic and administrative functions, and supporting leadership in achieving strategic objectives.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Master’s degree in a relevant discipline
* Minimum 15 years of experience in academic administration, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role

**Key Competencies**

* **Prior experience in dealing with Haryana higher education department for matters pertaining to state private university compliance.**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Legal and compliance awareness
* Strong organizational and documentation skills

  **UGC Act, 1956**
  , applicable State Private University Acts, Statutes, Ordinances, Rules, and Regulations of the University.
* Serve as the
  **Member Secretary (non-voting)**
  to statutory authorities including the Governing Body/Board of Governors, Board of Management, Academic Council, and other committees as prescribed.
* Convene meetings of statutory bodies, issue notices, prepare agendas, record proceedings, and maintain minutes and action taken reports in accordance with statutory requirements.
* Ensure timely submission of mandatory disclosures, returns, and reports to regulatory bodies including UGC and other authorities.
* **Facilitate institutional accreditation, ranking, and regulatory processes including NAAC, NBA, NIRF, UGC B-22 and other statutory assessments.**
* Act as a nodal officer for State Govt, UGC and other government bodies.

**2. Custodian of University Records & Seal**

* Act as the official custodian of all University records, proceedings, and the common seal of the University.
* Ensure secure maintenance, retrieval, and archiving of records in compliance with statutory and audit requirements.
* Authenticate official records, degrees, transcripts, and statutory documents on behalf of the University.

**3. Administration & Establishment Matters**

* Exercise administrative control over non-academic staff and supervise all administrative departments of the University.
* Act as the competent authority for leave, service records, and establishment matters of non-teaching employees, as per University rules.
* Ensure implementation of approved HR policies, service conditions, and disciplinary procedures in line with statutory provisions.

**4. Academic Administration & Regulatory Support**

* Maintain and preserve academic records, regulations, curricula documentation, and proceedings of academic bodies.
* Support the Academic Council and related bodies in the formulation and implementation of academic policies in compliance with UGC regulations.
* Ensure adherence to regulations relating to admissions, examinations, and award of degrees as prescribed by statutory authorities.

**5. Student Records, Services & Certification**

* Ensure accurate, confidential, and secure maintenance of student lifecycle records.
* Ensure proper documentation and audit trails for all student-related records.

**6. Legal & Statutory Matters**

* Coordinate with legal counsel on all institutional legal matters, including litigation, compliance, and documentation.
* Execute, verify, and authenticate contracts, agreements, MoUs, affidavits, and statutory declarations on behalf of the University as authorized.
* Represent the University before government authorities and external agencies as authorized.

**7. Student Affairs, Discipline & Statutory Compliance**

* Oversee student discipline and ensure implementation of statutory provisions including
  **anti-ragging regulations**
  , grievance redressal mechanisms, and student welfare guidelines issued by UGC and other authorities.
* Ensure establishment and effective functioning of statutory committees (e.g., Anti-Ragging Committee, Grievance Redressal Committee, ICC).

**8. Institutional Communication & Statutory Disclosures**

* Issue official notifications, circulars, and statutory communications on behalf of the University.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance in public disclosures.

**9. Additional Statutory Functions**

* Perform such duties as may be assigned by the Vice-Chancellor or prescribed under the Act, Statutes, and Ordinances of the University.
* Assist the Vice-Chancellor in ensuring effective governance, regulatory compliance, and administration of the University.

This role is critical to ensuring the smooth, compliant, and efficient functioning of the University’s academic and administrative ecosystem.

description:
**About the role**

Huru is looking for a
**Compliance Specialist – AML Operations**

to join its team in Delhi.

This is a hands-on
**player-coach role**

responsible for supporting Huru’s AML operations and protecting the organisation from financial crime. You will personally manage complex investigations and escalations while also overseeing the quality, allocation and timely completion of work across the AML operations team.

The role is ideal for an experienced AML professional who is ready to take the
**next step towards team leadership**

, while continuing to remain hands-on with complex cases.

You will be expected to operate with minimal supervision, identify emerging risks and trends, coach and support analysts, maintain high quality standards, and ensure AML activities are completed in line with
**UAE AML/CFT/CPF requirements**

.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Complex Investigations & Escalations**

* Personally handle complex and sensitive AML investigations, including linked accounts, customer networks, potential sanctions true matches and terrorist financing concerns.
* Act as an escalation point for analysts across
  **customer screening, transaction screening and transaction monitoring**

  cases.
* Review recommendations relating to the release, blocking or rejection of payments and ensure decisions are consistent with applicable policies.
* Draft high-quality
  **Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs)**

  for review by the DMLRO and ensure regulatory timelines are met.
* Escalate urgent or high-risk matters to the
  **Manager/DMLRO**

  with a clear investigation summary and recommended course of action.
* Ensure complex investigations are supported by appropriate evidence and clearly documented conclusions.

**2. Quality Assurance & Review**

* Conduct four-eyes quality checks across closed alerts and high-risk case dispositions.
* Review cases for accuracy, investigation quality, rationale and completeness of documentation.
* Review analysts’ draft
  **STRs/SARs**

  for evidence, clarity and timeliness before escalation to the Compliance Officer/MLRO.
* Review and sign off
  **Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)**

  and periodic review outcomes for high-risk customers, including source of funds and source of wealth assessments.
* Ensure case documentation meets the standards expected by Compliance, Internal Audit and regulators.
* Identify recurring quality gaps and work with analysts to improve investigation standards.

**3. Work Allocation & SLA Management**

* Allocate alert queues, investigations, periodic reviews and ad-hoc requests across the team based on analyst experience, workload and capacity.
* Monitor alert volumes, ageing, backlogs and regulatory/internal SLAs on a daily basis.
* Rebalance workloads where necessary to ensure cases are completed within required timelines.
* Forecast workload against team capacity and highlight potential resourcing risks to the Manager/DMLRO.
* Ensure sanctions alerts, urgent transactions and STR/SAR deadlines are appropriately prioritised.

**4. Team Leadership & Development**

* Support the day-to-day management of the AML operations team, including daily huddles and regular check-ins.
* Coach and mentor analysts on investigation techniques, financial crime typologies, UAE AML/CFT/CPF requirements and report writing.
* Support onboarding and training of new team members.
* Monitor individual productivity and quality and provide timely, constructive feedback.
* Contribute to performance discussions and reviews alongside the Manager/DMLRO.
* Deputise for the Manager when required and represent the team in relevant internal meetings.

**5. Team Culture & Ways of Working**

* Build a collaborative environment where analysts share knowledge, support each other and maintain high standards of work.
* Ensure work allocation, feedback and recognition are handled fairly and transparently.
* Identify workload pressure or potential burnout and raise concerns proactively.
* Address team challenges and conflicts constructively and at an early stage.
* Keep the team informed of changes in policies, procedures, priorities and regulatory requirements.
* Act as a communication bridge between the AML operations team and management.

**6. MIS, Trends & Control Improvements**

* Own daily, weekly and monthly AML operations MIS covering
  **alert volumes, ageing, outcomes, STR/SAR status, periodic reviews, productivity and quality KPIs**

  .
* Ensure MIS and reporting reconcile accurately with underlying source systems.
* Consolidate trends identified across investigations, including patterns by customer type, product, payment corridor or counterparty.
* Escalate material trends and emerging risks to the Head of Compliance & Risk with supporting analysis.
* Recommend improvements to monitoring rules, thresholds and procedures, including opportunities to reduce false positives.
* Maintain and improve AML operations procedures, desk guides and supporting documentation.
* Support the AML Manager and Compliance Head with policy updates, risk assessments, regulatory submissions, compliance projects and AML awareness training.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Independent:**

  Comfortable managing your own workload while supporting the wider team's objectives with minimal supervision.
* **Leadership potential:**

  Able to guide, coach and support analysts while remaining hands-on with complex investigations.
* **Proactive:**

  Identifies risks, issues and opportunities for improvement without waiting to be asked.
* **Solution-oriented:**

  Goes beyond identifying problems and recommends practical improvements to processes and controls.
* **Ownership mindset:**

  Takes responsibility for cases and team deliverables through to a clearly documented conclusion.
* **Sound judgement:**

  Knows when to make a decision independently and when escalation is required.
* **Collaborative:**

  Builds trust within the team and promotes knowledge-sharing and consistent standards.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in
  **Finance, Law, Commerce, Economics**

  , or a related discipline.
* **3–6 years of hands-on experience**

  in AML, screening, transaction monitoring or financial crime operations within an international regulated financial institution.
* Experience within a
  **CBUAE-licensed entity**

  would be an advantage.
* Strong hands-on experience investigating AML alerts end-to-end and handling complex or escalated cases.
* Experience drafting and/or reviewing
  **STRs/SARs**

  and preparing AML MIS.
* Previous experience
  **coaching, mentoring, reviewing the work of, or allocating work to junior analysts**

  would be highly desirable.
* **CAMS**

  or another recognised AML/financial crime certification would be a strong advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of
  **AML/CFT/CPF frameworks, concepts and processes**

  .
* Good understanding of relevant
  **Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE)**

  requirements and international standards, including FATF Recommendations.
* Strong investigation and analytical capabilities, with the ability to identify unusual transaction patterns and emerging financial crime risks.
* Strong understanding of
  **customer screening, transaction screening, transaction monitoring, CDD/EDD and sanctions controls**

  .
* Experience using AML/KYC platforms, screening systems, transaction monitoring tools and case-management systems.
* Strong Excel capabilities for analysis, reconciliation and management reporting.
* Excellent written English, with the ability to prepare and review clear, concise and defensible investigation summaries, STRs/SARs and reports.
* Strong organisational and workload-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and regulatory deadlines.
* Ability to coach others, provide constructive feedback and maintain high quality standards across a team.

**Why Join Huru?**

Huru operates in the fast-growing
**fintech and payments ecosystem**

, with a strong focus on innovation, customer experience and maintaining high regulatory standards.

At Huru, you will have the opportunity to:

* Take the next step from an experienced AML professional into a
  **player-coach/team leadership role**

  .
* Handle complex financial crime investigations while developing and supporting other AML professionals.
* Gain exposure to sophisticated AML, sanctions and financial crime operations.
* Work within a regulatory environment aligned with
  **UAE and international AML standards**

  .
* Influence AML processes, controls and operating standards as the organisation grows.
* Work closely with experienced Compliance, Risk and business teams.
* Join a growing organisation with opportunities for continued professional and leadership development.

this role makes AI the primary production method for substantive legal work. You remain responsible for verifying sources and exercising independent judgment.

   Family office and investment work is the primary long-term focus of this role. Fund subscriptions, side letters, custody arrangements, and lending terms can create restrictions and obligations that matter well beyond the initial transaction. The challenge is making those consequences clear before capital is committed so the CEO can decide with a practical understanding of the risks.

   The remit spans e-commerce, corporate matters, investments, and the CEO's personal legal needs, with no internal legal team to share the work. The challenge is maintaining verified advice, clear priorities, and consistent follow-through across all three workstreams without urgent matters obscuring emerging risks.

**The Career Accelerator**

This role combines hands-on ownership of commercial, investment, and personal legal matters with a direct line to the CEO and no layers between your advice and the decision.

**Your first 12 months:**

* Deliver a monthly Legal Exposure Audit covering material risks, deadlines, actions, unresolved decisions, and proactive recommendations across all three workstreams.

**You own the recommendation, the verification, and the follow-through.**

* Set day-to-day legal review priorities and investigative questions, choose approved research and drafting methods, and direct approved outside counsel within its authorized scope and budget. Reduce turnaround time and the total human effort required, including review, correction, and handoff, without lowering quality or bypassing controls. description:
**About Servify:**

Servify is a global product lifecycle management platform transforming the after-sales service experience. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in India, Servify connects leading OEM brands with their sales and service ecosystems to deliver seamless customer support and service operations. Servify partners with leading brands, retailers, distributors, insurers, service providers, and carriers across Asia, North America, Europe, and the MENA region.

Servify embraces and values diversity and is committed to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all members and will give equal consideration to all irrespective of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief.

**Why Join Servify?**

At Servify, you'll be part of a fast-growing global technology company that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. We offer competitive compensation, ESOPs, employee-friendly policies, modern collaboration tools, professional development opportunities, and benefits that help you do your best work.

**Position Summary:**
Servify is looking to engage a Global Data Protection Officer (DPO) & Global Privacy Lead, based in India, with 7+ years of PQE to lead the organization’s global privacy and data protection framework. The role will serve as the enterprise-wide authority for data protection, privacy governance, regulatory compliance, and privacy architecture across Servify’s operating geographies, including India, USA, Canada, EU, UK, Turkey, KSA, UAE, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain, and Qatar. Based in India to support statutory requirements under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA), the DPO will oversee cross-border privacy compliance, regulatory registrations, data subject/data principal rights and grievance mechanisms,privacy risk management, incident and breach response, and continuous improvement of Servify’s global privacy maturity. The role will work closely with Legal, Technology, Information Security, Product, HR, and Business teams to embed privacy-by-design and ensure compliance across all global operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead global data privacy and protection initiatives, ensuring compliance with applicable privacy regulations across Servify’s operating geographies.
* Act as the designated Data Protection Officer (DPO) for the Indian entity and coordinate with relevant regulatory authorities, where required.
* Provide strategic guidance to internal stakeholders on data privacy, protection, governance, risk management, and regulatory requirements.
* Develop, review, and maintain privacy policies, SOPs, consent mechanisms, data retention practices, and data sharing/processing agreements.
* Manage cross-border data transfers, including SCCs, Data Transfer Agreements, DPIAs, and related privacy controls.
* Oversee Record of Processing Activities (RoPA), DSAR registers, privacy audits, vendor assessments, and other data protection records.
* Lead the end-to-end Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) and grievance management process, ensuring timely and secure resolution.
* Act as the key SPOC for privacy audits, regulatory inquiries, investigations, and compliance assessments.
* Lead data breach and privacy incident response, including investigation, containment, remediation, escalation, and regulatory/data-subject notifications.
* Drive Privacy by Design and Privacy by Default across products, technology developments, integrations, and business processes.
* Assess privacy risks associated with AI/ML models, new products, high-risk processing activities, and technology implementations, and recommend appropriate controls.
* Partner with Technology, Information Security, Product, Legal, HR, Operations, and other functions to embed privacy controls across the organization.
* Develop and maintain privacy compliance dashboards and management reports, highlighting key risks, gaps, and remediation status.
* Develop and deliver data protection training and awareness programs for employees across the organization.

**Requirements:**

* Must be a full-time resident of India and available to support global operations.
* 12–18+ years of experience in data privacy, legal/compliance, cyber risk, regulatory affairs, or related areas, preferably within global technology, SaaS, TPA, consumer finance, or enterprise platforms.
* Meet the legal and professional requirements to be appointed/registered as a DPO with applicable regulatory authorities across Servify’s operating geographies.
* Strong and up-to-date knowledge of global data protection laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, notifications, and compliance requirements relevant to Servify’s business.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, engineering environments, data localization, encryption architectures, cookie compliance, AI/ML, Large Language Models (LLMs), and emerging privacy risks associated with AI.
* Hands-on experience implementing and managing enterprise privacy platforms such as OneTrust, Securiti.ai, TrustArc,BigID, or similar solutions.
* Ability to translate complex privacy and regulatory requirements into practical, actionable guidelines and controls for IT, Information Security, Audit, Legal, Product, and Business teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present privacy risks, compliance matters, and recommendations to senior leadership, Board, and C-Suite stakeholders.
* LLB/LLM or B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science from a recognized institution.
* At least two relevant privacy/cybersecurity certifications are highly preferred, such as CIPP/E, CIPP/A, CIPM, CIPT, FIP, CISA, or CDPSE.

title: Regulatory Affairs & FSMS Officer
description:
**BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF ORGANISATION, ITS BUSINESS AND FOCUS AREA.**

110-Year old family run Dairy based in Mumbai and on Mumbai-Gujarat highway, making high end quality dairy products and Indian sweets.

**Job Description**
– Regulatory Affairs & FSMS Officer

**Position**
- Regulatory Affairs & FSMS Officer

**Department**
-Quality Assurance / Regulatory Affairs

**Industry**
- Dairy, Indian Sweets & Food Manufacturing

**Job Purpose**

The Regulatory Affairs & FSMS Officer will be responsible for ensuring that the company's dairy, Indian sweets, and other food products are manufactured, handled, stored, distributed, and sold in compliance with applicable FSSAI requirements, Food Safety Management System (FSMS) requirements, internal SOPs, customer requirements, and applicable statutory regulations.

The role will involve close coordination with Manufacturing,Production,Quality Control,Quality Assurance, Maintenance,Engineering,Procurement,Warehouse,Logistics,Retail Operations, and other relevant departments to ensure that all required statutory and FSMS records are properly maintained, completed, reviewed, and compiled on a monthly basis.

The position will also conduct internal audits, identify compliance gaps, coordinate corrective actions, and ensure that the organization remains audit-ready at all times.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

1
**. FSSAI & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations, standards, notifications, orders, and requirements relevant to dairy products, Indian sweets, and other food products manufactured and sold by the company.
* Maintain and monitor all required FSSAI-related documentation, licenses, registrations, records, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure that statutory requirements are implemented at the operational level.
* Track changes in applicable food safety and regulatory requirements and communicate relevant changes to concerned departments.
* Ensure that product specifications, labels, declarations, ingredient information, allergen declarations, shelf-life requirements, and other regulatory information are appropriately reviewed and controlled.
* Coordinate with QC and other relevant teams for regulatory testing and documentation wherever required.
* Maintain an organized regulatory documentation system for easy retrieval during inspections, audits, and management reviews.

2.
**Monthly FSSAI & FSMS Documentation Coordination**

The officer will be responsible for collecting, reviewing, organizing, and compiling monthly compliance documentation from all relevant departments.

This will include coordinating with:

* Manufacturing
* Quality Control/Laboratory
* Quality Assurance
* Maintenance/Engineering
* Warehouse
* Procurement
* Stores
* Dispatch/Logistics
* Retail Operations
* Cleaning & Sanitation teams
* Pest-control service providers
* Other departments involved in food safety and operations

The officer will establish a monthly documentation checklist/calendar and ensure that required records are submitted by each department within defined timelines

3.
**FSMS Documentation & Record Control**

* Maintain and coordinate the company's Food Safety Management System (FSMS) documentation.
* Ensure that required FSMS records are generated, completed, reviewed, approved, and retained as per the company's document-control procedure.
* Maintain master lists of SOPs, formats, checklists, records, specifications, and controlled documents.
* Ensure that obsolete documents are withdrawn and only current versions are available at points of use.
* Coordinate periodic review and revision of SOPs and food-safety documentation.
* Ensure proper filing and retrieval of physical and electronic records.
* Maintain a monthly FSMS compliance file/dashboard for management review.

4.
**Internal Audits & Compliance Audits**

* Prepare and execute an annual/monthly internal audit plan covering manufacturing, production, QC, maintenance,Warehouse,Retail,Hygiene,Sanitation, and other relevant functions.
* Conduct internal audits to verify compliance with:
* FSSAI requirements
* FSMS requirements
* Company SOPs
* GMP/GHP requirements
* Hygiene and sanitation requirements
* Internal quality standards
* Food safety procedures
* Identify non-conformities, observations, and areas of improvement.
* Prepare internal audit reports and communicate findings to concerned department heads.
* Assign responsibility and target dates for corrective actions.
* Follow up on CAPA implementation and verify effectiveness.
* Escalate overdue or critical compliance issues to the management.

5.
**Coordination with Manufacturing & Production**

* Work closely with Manufacturing and Production teams to ensure food-safety and regulatory requirements are incorporated into daily operations.
* Verify that production records and process-control records are properly maintained.
* Monitor compliance with hygiene, sanitation, temperature, process, and handling requirements.
* Review production-related documentation as part of monthly FSMS compilation.
* Identify recurring compliance issues and coordinate corrective actions with Production.

6.
**Coordination with Quality Control / Laboratory**

* Coordinate with QC to ensure that required testing records and reports are maintained.
* Ensure that raw-material, in-process, finished-product, water, environmental, and microbiological testing records, as applicable, are available and properly documented.
* Track pending or overdue test reports.
* Coordinate with QC regarding deviations and out-of-specification results.
* Ensure that relevant laboratory records are incorporated into the monthly compliance file.

7.
**Coordination with Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure that maintenance-related food-safety documentation is maintained.
* Monitor records relating to preventive maintenance of food-contact and critical equipment.
* Coordinate documentation for calibration of critical measuring and monitoring equipment.
* Ensure that maintenance activities affecting food safety are appropriately documented.
* Verify that post-maintenance cleaning and hygiene requirements are followed where applicable.
* Monitor issues such as water systems, refrigeration, temperature-control equipment, drainage, lighting, ventilation, and other infrastructure relevant to food safety.

8.
**Retail & Outlet Compliance**

For company-owned or managed retail outlets:

* Conduct/coordinate periodic food-safety and hygiene audits.
* Verify compliance with approved SOPs for handling, storage, display, temperature control, cleaning, sanitation, and personal hygiene.
* Ensure that required retail records and checklists are completed.
* Coordinate corrective actions with retail managers.
* Consolidate retail compliance information into the monthly FSMS report.
* Identify recurring non-compliances across outlets and recommend preventive actions.

9.
**Documentation for External Audits & Regulatory Inspections**

* Maintain the organization in a continuous state of audit readiness.
* Coordinate preparation of documentation for FSSAI inspections, customer audits, certification audits, and other regulatory/third-party audits.
* Act as the documentation coordinator during audits.
* Ensure that requested records are retrieved and presented in a timely manner.
* Maintain records of audit observations and regulatory findings.
* Track commitments and deadlines arising from regulatory or certification audits.

10.
**Food Safety Training & Awareness**

* Coordinate food-safety and FSMS training programs with the QA/HR/Training teams.
* Ensure relevant employees are trained on applicable SOPs, GMP/GHP, hygiene, food safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain training calendars and attendance records.
* Monitor completion of mandatory training.
* Support food-safety awareness programs across manufacturing and retail locations.

12.
**Regulatory Calendar & Compliance Tracker**

* Develop and maintain a Regulatory Compliance Calendar.
* Track validity/renewal dates for applicable licenses, registrations, certificates, contracts, testing requirements, and other statutory obligations.
* Maintain reminders for upcoming regulatory submissions, renewals, audits, testing, inspections, and reviews.
* Ensure that no critical compliance requirement expires or remains unattended.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* monthly FSMS documentation completed on time
* regulatory compliance requirements completed
* Number of overdue compliance actions
* Number of internal audit non-conformities
* CAPA closure rate within agreed timelines
* Repeat non-conformity rate
* SOP compliance percentage
* Audit readiness score
* Number of missed/expired regulatory requirements
* Department-wise documentation compliance
* Timeliness of monthly compliance report
* Number of critical observations during external/regulatory audits

**The Regulatory Affairs & FSMS Officer should have the authority to:**

* Request required records from any concerned department.
* Identify and report regulatory/food-safety non-compliances.
* Raise internal audit observations.
* Escalate critical food-safety or regulatory deviations.
* Request corrective action from responsible departments.
* Follow up on overdue CAPAs.
* Stop or escalate a process/documentation activity where there is a significant food-safety or regulatory concern, in accordance with the company's escalation procedure.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, or a related field.

**Experience**

* Approximately 3–7 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, QA, FSMS, Food Safety, or Quality Assurance in the dairy, food manufacturing, sweets, FMCG, or related food industry.
* Experience working with dairy products and/or Indian sweets will be preferred.
* Experience coordinating across Production, QC, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Retail will be highly desirable.

**Job Posting Location.**

Mumbai. If needed, will have to travel to other Company locations.

Working hours: 9 hours per day

Work week: 6 days per week

Mandatory working on all festival days.

Job Requirements

Will have to travel to other locations as and when required.

description:
Role overview

* We are hiring a qualified Company Secretary with 2–4 years of post-qualification experience for incorporation and end-to-end secretarial compliance for a portfolio of companies and LLPs within the group

Key responsibilitiesIncorporation and entity set-up

•        Incorporate private, companies through SPICe+ (Part A and B), e-MoA / e-AoA and AGILE-PRO-S, including name reservation and DIN allotment.

•        Incorporate LLPs through RUN-LLP and FiLLiP, and draft and file LLP agreements in Form 3 within the statutory timeline.

•        Handle post-incorporation steps: INC-20A (commencement of business), first board meeting, first auditor appointment, share certificates, statutory registers, and PAN / TAN / GST / bank account coordination.

•        Manage conversions and restructuring filings, such as private company to LLP, LLP to company, private to public, and changes of name, object or registered office.

•        Handle closure of dormant entities through strike-off (STK-2 for companies, Form 24 for LLPs).

Company law compliance (Companies Act, 2013)

•        Maintain a compliance calendar and file annual returns and financial statements on time: MGT-7 / MGT-7A and AOC-4 (including XBRL where applicable).

•        File event-based forms: DIR-12, ADT-1, MGT-14, PAS-3, SH-7, CHG-1/4, INC-22, DPT-3, MSME-1, BEN-2 and similar.

•        Track director and entity KYC (DIR-3 KYC, INC-22A ACTIVE) and DIN / DPIN status.

•        Convene board, committee and general meetings in line with Secretarial Standards SS-1 and SS-2: notices, agendas, board papers, minutes and resolutions.

•        Maintain statutory registers (members, directors and KMP, charges, contracts with related parties, SBO) and the minutes books.

•        Manage share capital actions: allotments, rights issues, private placements, transfers, transmissions, buy-backs, and dematerialisation of private company securities with ISIN set-up.

LLP compliance (LLP Act, 2008)

•        File the LLP annual return (Form 11) and Statement of Account & Solvency (Form 8) by their due dates.

•        File event-based LLP forms: changes in designated partners and partners (Form 4), LLP agreement amendments (Form 3), registered office changes (Form 15), and contribution changes.

•        Maintain partner records, contribution details and LLP agreement versions for each LLP.

Advisory, coordination and records

•        Track regulatory changes from MCA, RBI and SEBI, and brief the team on what affects group entities.

•        Respond to notices from the Registrar of Companies and manage adjudication, compounding or condonation filings when needed.

•        Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax advisors, bankers, and the RTA or depositories.

•        Keep a central, audit-ready repository of incorporation documents, approvals, filings and SRNs for every entity.

Qualifications and experience

**Required**

•        Associate Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ACS).

•        2–4 years of post-qualification experience in secretarial compliance.

•        Has personally handled at least 10 company or LLP incorporations end to end.

•        Has run annual compliance for a portfolio of multiple companies and LLPs at the same time.

•        Hands-on filing experience on the MCA V3 portal.

**Preferred**

•        Experience with dematerialisation of private company shares and RTA coordination.
